merge_chrome_traces: merge Chrome trace files from multiple TP, DP, PP, EP ranks into a single gzipped JSON trace
get_merge_summary: get a summary of the merged trace including total events, source files, and device properties count
discover_trace_files: discover all trace files matching a profile ID in the output directory
extract_rank_info: extract TP, DP, PP, EP rank numbers from a trace filename
create_rank_label: create a formatted rank label string from extracted rank info for PID labeling
